page_title: BAY 8-0 DAR | Bayern Munich v Darmstadt 28/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+2' That's the end of the match.
90' We will have 2 min. of added time.

90' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.

88' 8 - 0 Goal! Leroy Sane plays in Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom left corner 8:0.
86' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.

84' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Marcel Schuhen leaps like a salmon to deny him.
83' Martin Petersen interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich).
80' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
77' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jamal Musiala as he is replaced by Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich).
77' A substitution has been made. Konrad Laimer goes off and Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) comes on.
77' Thomas Tuchel has decided to make a change. Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) replaces Matthijs de Ligt.

76' 7 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Thomas Muller, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich), who beats Marcel Schuhen with a brilliant shot into the left side of the net. 7:0.
72' It is time for a substitution. Thomas Poppler Isherwood (Darmstadt) is on for Christoph Klarer.

71' 6 - 0 Goal! Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Noussair Mazraoui inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the middle of the goal. 6:0.
69' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) goes into the referee's book for dissent.

69' 5 - 0 What a beautiful moment! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top of the net. Marcel Schuhen just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 5:0.
69' Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
67' The linesman raises his flag. Frans Kratzig (Bayern Munich) is adjudged offside.
65' Thomas Tuchel decides to make a substitution. Alphonso Davies will be replaced by Frans Kratzig (Bayern Munich).
65' Here comes a substitution. Kingsley Coman is given a rest as he is replaced by Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich).
64' 4 - 0 Goal! Kingsley Coman plays a short, square pass into the path of Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich), who bends a shot straight into the left side of the goal to make it 4:0. Fabulous goal!
61' Substitution. Marvin Mehlem did his best and is replaced by Bartol Franjic (Darmstadt).
61' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to substitute Tobias Kempe and he is replaced by Emir Karic (Darmstadt).
60' 3 - 0 Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
60' Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Martin Petersen no option but to blow his whistle.
56' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Konrad Laimer tees up Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) inside the box and he rolls the ball past Marcel Schuhen.
55' Bayern Munich fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
54' Bayern Munich failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
51' 1 - 0 Goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Noussair Mazraoui and easily beat the keeper with a header into the left side of the goal from close range. 1:0.
50' Bayern Munich have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

50' Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Marcel Schuhen pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
49' Matthias Bader (Darmstadt) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
47' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) but poses no threat.
47' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) on the edge of the box.
47' A clumsy foul by Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) and Martin Petersen blows his whistle.
46' Half-time substitution. Fabian Schnellhardt is replaced by Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' The goal by Bayern Munich won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
45+2' We are about to witness a subsitution. Christoph Zimmermann (Darmstadt) for Luca Pfeiffer.
45+1' Attention! Referee Martin Petersen straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) has a goal ruled out for offside!
43' The corner kick from Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
41' Matej Maglica (Darmstadt) cannot believe that he has been told to leave the field of play after the referee blows his whistle and sends him off!
38' Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
38' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) makes a strong challenge and Martin Petersen blows for a foul.
37' Manuel Neuer pulls off a great save to deny Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
36' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
30' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the left post.
26' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) brings his opponent down. Martin Petersen has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) lashes the free kick from the edge of the box but it flies high over the bar, somewhere into the stands.
21' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) has to leave the pitch!
20' The Bayern Munich players can’t believe it after referee Martin Petersen signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
20' Referee Martin Petersen makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Bayern Munich. Let’s see what happens!
19' Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
19' Martin Petersen blows his whistle and signals a foul after Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) brought his opponent down. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Bayern Munich.
19' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Darmstadt comes to nothing.
15' Martin Petersen blows his whistle. Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) commits a foul after dangerous play.
15' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.

14' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) won himself some space after the corner kick and tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box. His effort is directed towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes the save.
14' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) will take the corner.
13' A snap shot by Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Marcel Schuhen produces a good save to thwart him.
13' Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) tackles a bit over-zealously and Martin Petersen blows for a foul.
7' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) works the corner short.
7' Referee Martin Petersen halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Thomas Tuchel, then shows him a yellow.

7' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) controls the ball from the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper has a clear sight of the shot and thwarts him with a comfortable save.
6' The free kick from Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out.
4' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) makes a horrible challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Bayern Munich will take the kick-off.
Martin Petersen will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
Show lineups
Welcome to our live text commentary, ladies and gentlemen! The starting lineups will be announced very soon, so just sit back and get ready to enjoy the action.
